parsed.doc_summary: San Diego City Council staff report and draft ordinance (O-2025-107) adding Mun. Code Div. 11, §§98.1101-98.1104, banning sale/licensing/use of algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data. The document is the proposed draft (final passage date blank); the effective date is 30 days after final passage, so it cannot be computed from this document.

rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic software that analyzes nonpublic competitor data to set rents or occupancy levels, and vendors may not sell or license such software to landlords. Tenants can sue for injunctions, damages, or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, plus attorney's fees.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation
citation_aliases: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance
San Diego Mun. Code ch. 9, art. 8, div. 11
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.effective_date_note: This document is the draft with blank final-passage date; the ordinance takes effect on the thirtieth day from and after final passage. Other sources indicate adoption in June 2025, but this document does not state the date. The document is a proposal, so enactment is not confirmed here.
rules.penalty: Injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; each month and each property is a separate violation; prevailing tenant recovers costs and attorney's fees.
rules.exemptions: Excludes software publishing reports from aggregated historical nonpublic data more than 90 days old or public information that does not recommend future rents; software used to set rents or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to landlords and residential rental property in the City of San Diego.
rules.conflict_note: Source is a draft ordinance with blank adoption date; the status 'enacted' relies on the corpus context (adopted June 2025).

unverifiable_exemptions: software used for affordable housing program rent/income limits
